title: lib.rs: register_mail_handlers skeleton + 26 method stubs
description:
Create src/lib.rs with register_mail_handlers<B: MailBackend> that registers all 26 RFC 8621 method handlers with the Dispatcher. Each handler module is called here.

## What to implement

pub fn register_mail_handlers<B>(dispatcher: &mut Dispatcher<CallerCtx>, backend: Arc<B>)
where B: MailBackend + Send + Sync + 'static

Registers exactly these 26 methods (names must match RFC 8621 §1.4 exactly):
- Email/get, Email/changes, Email/query, Email/queryChanges, Email/set, Email/copy, Email/import, Email/parse
- Mailbox/get, Mailbox/changes, Mailbox/query, Mailbox/queryChanges, Mailbox/set
- Thread/get, Thread/changes
- Identity/get, Identity/changes, Identity/set
- EmailSubmission/get, EmailSubmission/changes, EmailSubmission/query, EmailSubmission/queryChanges, EmailSubmission/set
- VacationResponse/get, VacationResponse/set
- SearchSnippet/get

Each handler stub: async fn handle_X_get<B: MailBackend>(ctx: CallerCtx, req: MethodRequest, backend: Arc<B>) -> Invocation

Stubs can return JmapError::server_fail("not implemented") initially — individual issues fill them in.

## Source references
- jmap-chat-server register pattern: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap-chat-server/src/lib.rs
- RFC 8621 §1.4 for exact method name strings
- jmap-server Dispatcher API: crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo check -p jmap-mail-server passes with all 26 stubs registered
- Method name strings tested: one #[test] fn method_names_are_registered that calls register_mail_handlers with a test Dispatcher and checks all 26 method names exist
- No unwrap/expect; #[forbid(unsafe_code)]
